From 3ddb4ce1e6e3bd112778ab93bbd9092f23a878ec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Colin Ian King <colin.king@canonical.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2021 11:55:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] serial: tegra: Fix a mask operation that is always true

Currently the expression lsr | UART_LSR_TEMT is always true and
this seems suspect. I believe the intent was to mask lsr with UART_LSR_TEMT
to check that bit, so the expression should be using the & operator
instead. Fix this.

Fixes: b9c2470fb150 ("serial: tegra: flush the RX fifo on frame error")
Signed-off-by: Colin Ian King <colin.king@canonical.com>
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210426105514.23268-1-colin.king@canonical.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/tty/serial/serial-tegra.c b/drivers/tty/serial/serial-tegra.c
index bbae072a125d..222032792d6c 100644
--- a/drivers/tty/serial/serial-tegra.c
+++ b/drivers/tty/serial/serial-tegra.c
@@ -338,7 +338,7 @@ static void tegra_uart_fifo_reset(struct tegra_uart_port *tup, u8 fcr_bits)
 
 	do {
 		lsr = tegra_uart_read(tup, UART_LSR);
-		if ((lsr | UART_LSR_TEMT) && !(lsr & UART_LSR_DR))
+		if ((lsr & UART_LSR_TEMT) && !(lsr & UART_LSR_DR))
 			break;
 		udelay(1);
 	} while (--tmout);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/tty/serial/serial-tegra.c`**
   - The line of code:
     ```c
     if ((lsr | UART_LSR_TEMT) && !(lsr & UART_LSR_DR))
     ```
     was modified to:
     ```c
     if ((lsr & UART_LSR_TEMT) && !(lsr & UART_LSR_DR))
     ```
   - This change alters the bitwise operation from a logical OR (`|`) to a logical AND (`&`) for the `UART_LSR_TEMT` mask, correcting the logic to properly check if the `UART_LSR_TEMT` bit is set.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug identified in the previous implementation, which was likely causing incorrect behavior in the serial communication by always evaluating the condition as true. The fix ensures that the code now correctly checks the status of the `UART_LSR_TEMT` bit, which is essential for the intended functionality of flushing the RX FIFO on frame errors. This change is linked to the previous commit identified by the hash `b9c2470fb150`, which introduced the original faulty logic.

```c
if ((lsr & UART_LSR_TEMT) && !(lsr & UART_LSR_DR))
```
